.omx/research/charters/ddm_vg1_reclaim_process_gate_cwd_census_robust_20260910.md:6:Find why the cwd census is malformed on a visible host (likely: `lsof -d cwd` output shape on macOS — kernel/zombie rows without a cwd, permission-denied rows for other users' processes, or a parse that requires every pid to have a cwd row) and fix the census so that (a) a visible host with some unreadable cwd rows yields a COMPLETE census with those pids recorded as `cwd_unreadable` (and the gate refuses only if an unreadable pid's COMMAND matches the owner token), (b) a host with no process visibility still raises PROCESS_VISIBILITY_UNAVAILABLE. Do not run apply; hand MAIN the exact command (ledger sha unchanged unless you re-plan).
.omx/research/ddm_vr4_both_ssds_certified_reclaim_successor_20260909.md:16:`pgrep -alf 'ddm_(sj1|rp1|bnd1|cmp2)|inflate|reclaim'` returned 3: `sysmon request failed with error: sysmond service not found` and `pgrep: Cannot get process list`. Exact commands and output are retained in `ddm_vr4_20260909/process_gate.json`.
.omx/research/ddm_cd3_ssd_code_debt_final_20260910.md:84:`experiments/ddm_vr3_certified_raw_reclaim.py::process_gate` reads `ps ... comm=`, exact-name `pgrep -x`, and lsof process COMMAND/cwd fields. It no longer scans full argv text. An owner token must have boundaries on both sides. Every relevant ps process must have cwd evidence; every lsof cwd process must have a COMMAND. Extra processes first observed by lsof also have their command checked. The short-lived ps observer is accounted for by its command and parent PID. Unknown/malformed records, missing cwd, unavailable ps/pgrep/lsof, and warnings all fail closed.
.omx/research/ddm_cd3_ssd_code_debt_final_20260910.md:86:The inherited sw2 patch incorrectly allowed a self-only cwd census. Review caught and fixed this before packaging. The bz2d journal's ruff argv reference is reproduced by the argv-only fixture; real owner command/cwd controls still refuse. All existing archive/runtime/hash/reference/open-descriptor gates remain in the executor. A complete host process view is still required, so this proposal does not promise that MAIN's apply will pass.
